row.evidence: Mediaocean publishes no pricing (new customers "fill out the form" on the contact page); its help centre confirms SSO for "clients using federated authentication" but has no public SCIM or provisioning article, and the developer portal requires registration.
row.notes: New row. Mediaocean (Prisma, Spectra, Lumina; owns Innovid and Flashtalking) is quote-only: no pricing page, sales via the contact form. Federated SSO for its browser-based apps is documented in release notes; which contract includes it is not public. The Zendesk help centre exposes only about 393 public articles to anonymous visitors (search for SCIM: 0, Okta: 0, provisioning: only privacy documents), and developer.mediaocean.com returns 403 until you register, so absence of SCIM cannot be confirmed. Not in Okta's OIN; no Entra tutorial.

scim.notes: No SCIM documentation found in the public help centre; most help articles and the API portal need a login.

user_api.notes: developer.mediaocean.com (API Explorer) is login-gated: 'You don't have permission to read Home.'

fallbacks.notes: SSO (federated authentication) exists for Mediaocean browser-based apps; provisioning behaviour is undocumented publicly. Most help content and the API portal need a login.
